title: Statement
description: One sourced claim about one field of one entity. The atomic unit of Atlas; entities are views over statements.

statement_id.description: Deterministic hash of (entity_id, field, value, source, source_record_id). One statement per source record; stable across re-runs.

entity_id.description: Source-scoped entity identifier, '<source>:<key>'. Resolution maps entity ids to atlas ids; adapters never assign atlas ids.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the jurisdiction the statement is about.

field.description: Dotted path into the Business record, for example 'canonical_name', 'sector.source_category', 'identifiers'.

value.description: The asserted value as text. List and struct values are JSON text.

source_ref.description: URL, document name, or API call that produced the value.

source_record_id.description: The source's own key for the row, or a deterministic hash of the row when the source publishes none.

asserted_at.description: When the source was pulled, or when the operator asserted the value.

licence.description: Licence of the source material, as an SPDX identifier or 'public-record'.
